The loop body moves into `JudgeExpressCall` and `ResolveRoute` with the same checks in the same order, so behaviour is unchanged; `ExpressAndFastify` drops to roughly a loop plus a nested `if`, well under 15; and the code should compile, because `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` on the nullable tuple rejects `null` and leaves all three variables assigned on the success path (I reviewed the diff only and did not build it).
